legend: The Loch Ness Monster (Scotland, May 1933 sighting, Saint Columba legend)
lines: Loch Ness, Scotland, May nineteen thirty-three.
A hotel manager and his wife drive along the shore.
They say the dark water suddenly begins to boil.
A huge humped back rises, big as a whale.
Then a long neck lifts, and a small head looks around.
The newspaper calls it a monster, and the world goes wild.
A famous photo was later called a fake.
But legend says a beast has lurked here since the days of Saint Columba.
Is it a real animal, or just a legend? What do you think?
title: Loch Ness Monster: The Night the Water Began to Boil #shorts
description:
In May 1933 a hotel manager and his wife said the water of Loch Ness began to boil and a huge creature rose up. The legend of the monster is much older.
